name: Maria Cantwell
committees: Senate Commerce, Science, and Transportation (ranking member)
stance: Wants federal agencies and national labs, not companies, to test the most powerful frontier models, and opposes preemption of state AI laws without strong federal guardrails.

statements.text: The Senate came together tonight to say that we can't just run over good state consumer protection laws.

This executive order's overly broad preemption threatens states with lawsuits and funding cuts for protecting their residents from AI-powered frauds, scams, and deepfakes—leaving American consumers without any protection.
At a Commerce hearing, argued that the national laboratories and federal cybersecurity and biodefense experts must lead testing of advanced AI models rather than industry self-certification.
We are hearing that artificial superintelligence is coming.
Pressed in Commerce negotiations for mandatory testing of frontier models by federal experts, against the Cruz-Klobuchar-Thune draft that lets companies test their own models.
